paragraph: Harrington Park is a single-family market and nothing else, with 23 sales over six months at a median of $999,999. The sale-to-list ratio is 1.0436, 78 percent of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 13. That is a real seller's market, with multiple offer situations behind a good share of those numbers. Sales ran from $700,000 to $2,175,000, so the median is the better guide than the ends. Monthly closings are too thin to read a trend from any single month, though volume did build into June and July the way Bergen County summers usually go. If the town follows the normal seasonal arc, expect fall closings to thin out and the median to drift with whatever mix happens to close.
